[SWS_DM_01221] End patterns of a DynamicAccessList
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04240, RS_Diag_04234
⌈
If any of the overloads of the method
ara::diag::DynamicAccessList-
DiagServiceBuilder::EndsWith
of the class
ara::diag::DynamicAc-
cessListDiagServiceBuilder
are called by the application, the
Diagnostic
Server instance
shall add the requested pattern to the end of the DynamicAc-
cessList.
⌋
